anomaly.description: The current target state no longer matches the state used during approval.

violations.name: Permanent Hold Without Resolution Path
violations.reason: The operation entered HELD but no recovery, restriction, termination, escalation, or re-authorization path was defined.

violations.name: Incomplete Resolution Trace
violations.reason: The trace cannot link the held state to any defined resolution or recovery process.

SAFETY-INV-002.reason: Planning, auditing, approval, and execution roles were logically separated.

SAFETY-INV-003.reason: The action passed through authority and pre-execution controls before the anomaly was detected.

SAFETY-INV-004.reason: Containment was triggered by an observable target-state mismatch.

SAFETY-INV-005.reason: The operation correctly entered a reversible HELD state before further execution.

SAFETY-INV-006.reason: No independent verifier was assigned to resolve the held condition.

SAFETY-INV-007.reason: The anomaly remained bounded to the affected operation and target.

SAFETY-INV-008.reason: The trace ends at containment and provides no resolution or recovery linkage.

SAFETY-INV-009.reason: The held operation has no defined path toward recovery, restriction, re-authorization, isolation, or termination.

SAFETY-INV-010.reason: Multiple logical safety actors exist, despite the missing resolution process.

expected_safe_behavior.reason: Containment is temporary. A held operation must have at least one explicit terminal or recovery path.
required_actions: define a review or recovery deadline
define at least one valid resolution path
allow re-authorization only after fresh evaluation
allow restriction or isolation if recovery is incomplete
allow termination if safe continuation is not justified
record the selected resolution path in trace
